args.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original production game cinematic art, mature dark fantasy, sophisticated painterly anime realism with expressive faces, tactile cloth, restrained light and cinematic compositions. Output ONE image contact sheet with EXACTLY FOUR equal rectangular 16:9 panels in 2 columns x 2 rows, no gutters, no borders, no writing. Ideally total 3072x1728. Each quadrant is one complete shot, strict grid. Image 1 reference keyart defines the two adult protagonists: Noen black tousled hair, black leather and gold trim; Aelia silver-blond long hair, thin gold star crown, white-gold mantle, navy gown, sapphire brooch. Keep faces, outfit and age faithful. Image 2 reference defines SAME modest rectangular limestone chapel: west windows left light, north altar rear, long oak table mid-right, east side door on right. No cathedral enlargement, new doors or new rooms. Image 3 portrait atlas: prelate is BOTTOM row CENTER, elderly short silver hair, clean-shaven, white-gold stole; guards bottom row second, kettle helmet, mail and breastplate. No protagonists' redesign, no romance, no text/UI. Sequence A, clockwise reading order ROW MAJOR: TOP LEFT: peaceful wide shot, Aelia holds a paper list and staff to right of prelate at oak table, Noen approaches from near left with folded pass. TOP RIGHT: dynamic medium shot, Noen at right corner of oak table drives a small dagger into prelate's chest, very small restrained red stain, prelate shocked and falling sideways against table; Aelia behind right gasps and reaches out. BOTTOM LEFT: low intimate shot, prelate fallen beside table with same small stain; Aelia kneels on right reaching her LEFT hand toward wound with soft golden healing light, staff in RIGHT hand; Noen between her and casualty holds left forearm across her way, dagger held down, her expression urgent focused grief. BOTTOM RIGHT: Aelia upright at right, pushes a small translucent golden shield left with her left palm to open access to casualty, Noen at left sidesteps toward table's RIGHT edge beyond shield, fallen prelate behind near table. All hands anatomically correct. Distinct deliberate poses per panel. Keep entire faces, hands and action in middle 70% of each frame, reserve bottom 15% simple floor for runtime subtitles.
